## Summary

This presentation reports the first measurement of the transverse-momentum dependence of
radial-flow fluctuations, $v_0(p_T)$, over $0.5 < p_T < 10$ GeV in Pb+Pb collisions at
$\sqrt{s_{\mathrm{NN}}}=5.02$ TeV with the ATLAS detector. The measurement satisfies three
major hallmarks of collectivity: $p_T$ factorization, long-range correlations in
pseudorapidity, and a centrality-independent response shape. Comparisons with hydrodynamic
models further demonstrate the sensitivity of $v_0(p_T)$ to the bulk viscosity of the QGP.

## Recognition

::: {.project-award}
**Andre Mischke Award — Best Experimental Talk**

The Andre Mischke Award was established in memory of Andre Mischke—a friend, educator,
and scholar whose career combined major contributions to heavy-flavour physics with a deep
commitment to mentoring and supporting young scientists—and is awarded for the best
experimental presentation by a young scientist at SQM.

This presentation received the Andre Mischke Award at SQM 2026.
